artworks.alt: The risen Jesus Christ shares bread with disciples beside a small fire on the shore.
artworks.caption: Bread passes from hand to hand beside the morning fire. The risen Savior welcomes His disciples to a meal before inviting Peter to care for His sheep. Read the encounter in

artworks.title: Until He Finds It
artworks.alt: Christ as the Good Shepherd approaches one sheep among rocks and scrub at dusk.
artworks.caption: One sheep stands apart among the rocks, and the shepherd turns toward it. This scene invites us into the persistent care of the lost-sheep parable in
artworks.research: Luke 15:4-7 is a parable about seeking until finding, followed by rejoicing. This is an interpretive Christ-as-shepherd scene, not a claim of a recorded historical rescue. Ancient Levantine landscape, garments and dusk are artistic choices; no named disciple is invented.
artworks.review: Initial gaze was too far forward. Corrected candidate lowers chin and eyes toward sheep; supporting_review independently passed likeness vs approved Home reference, focused expression, anatomy and clear distinction from carried-lamb scene.
